title: 新加坡濱海堤壩
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction
summary: 本課以新加坡濱海堤壩為入口，深入都市逕流、潮位排水、抽水能源與水庫水質。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Marina Barrage as its entry point, this course examines urban runoff, tidal drainage, pumping energy and reservoir water quality. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「集水區逕流峰值」與「庫容與淨入流」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Catchment runoff peak" and "Storage and net inflow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 集水區逕流峰值：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Catchment runoff peak: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「集水區逕流峰值」如何影響新加坡濱海堤壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Catchment runoff peak” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Marina Barrage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 都市不透水面提高快速逕流比例，但降雨空間與集流時間控制峰值。合理化公式適合指定的小型集水區條件，不能直接代表整個大型水庫入流歷線。 假設集水區2 km²、C=0.75、雨強60 mm/h且歷時超過集流時間；Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s，未含渠道滯蓄。 短時局部暴雨可能不符合均勻降雨假設，排水瓶頸也會改變峰值時間。把每個分區峰值直接相加，可能錯估各峰不同時到達的真實入流。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「集水區逕流峰值」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Impervious surfaces increase rapid runoff, while rainfall distribution and concentration time control the peak. The rational method applies to specified small-catchment conditions, not a complete large-reservoir inflow hydrograph. Assume area 2 km², C=0.75 and intensity 60 mm/h lasting beyond concentration time. Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s, excluding channel storage. Brief localized storms violate uniform rainfall assumptions, and drainage bottlenecks alter peak timing. Adding every subcatchment peak directly can misrepresent the actual combined inflow when peaks arrive at different times. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Catchment runoff peak” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設集水區2 km²、C=0.75、雨強60 mm/h且歷時超過集流時間；Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s，未含渠道滯蓄。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume area 2 km², C=0.75 and intensity 60 mm/h lasting beyond concentration time.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「各分區最大流量無須考慮時序就能直接相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Subcatchment peak discharges can be added directly without considering their timing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「集水區逕流峰值」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Catchment runoff peak”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 集水區逕流峰值
knowledge.text: 都市不透水面提高快速逕流比例，但降雨空間與集流時間控制峰值。合理化公式適合指定的小型集水區條件，不能直接代表整個大型水庫入流歷線。
knowledge.textEn: Impervious surfaces increase rapid runoff, while rainfall distribution and concentration time control the peak. The rational method applies to specified small-catchment conditions, not a complete large-reservoir inflow hydrograph.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：各分區最大流量無須考慮時序就能直接相加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Subcatchment peak discharges can be added directly without considering their timing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「新加坡濱海堤壩」的「集水區逕流峰值：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出流域、入流、儲存、出流與下游的水量邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「水庫數據調度桌」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與同時間窗的流量、水位、截面與儀器校正紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Catchment runoff peak: mechanism and system paths” in “Marina Barrage”. Draw the catchment, inflow, storage, outflow and downstream water balance; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Reservoir data planning desk” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for flow, level, section and calibration records for the same time window, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「集水區逕流峰值」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Catchment runoff peak" is correct?
options: 各分區最大流量無須考慮時序就能直接相加。
都市不透水面提高快速逕流比例，但降雨空間與集流時間控制峰值。
水庫水位不變就表示沒有大量水量流入與流出。
optionsEn: Subcatchment peak discharges can be added directly without considering their timing.
Impervious surfaces increase rapid runoff, while rainfall distribution and concentration time control the peak.
An unchanged reservoir level means there is no substantial inflow or outflow.
quiz.explanation: 都市不透水面提高快速逕流比例，但降雨空間與集流時間控制峰值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Impervious surfaces increase rapid runoff, while rainfall distribution and concentration time control the peak. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 集水區逕流峰值：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Catchment runoff peak: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「集水區逕流峰值」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Catchment runoff peak” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設集水區2 km²、C=0.75、雨強60 mm/h且歷時超過集流時間；Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s，未含渠道滯蓄。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume area 2 km², C=0.75 and intensity 60 mm/h lasting beyond concentration time. Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s, excluding channel storage. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用雨量站與雷達核對雨強是否覆蓋集水區，再比較出口流量和延遲；將土地利用變更、排水分區和所選集流時間附在計算表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check rain-gauge and radar coverage, then compare outlet flow and lag.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設集水區2 km²、C=0.75、雨強60 mm/h且歷時超過集流時間；Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s，未含渠道滯蓄。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume area 2 km², C=0.75 and intensity 60 mm/h lasting beyond concentration time. Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s, excluding channel storage.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「集水區逕流峰值」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Catchment runoff peak", which statement holds?
options: 抽水機已經運轉就表示一定達到額定排水流量。
沒有明顯噪音就足以證明吸水條件有足夠餘裕。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設集水區2 km²、C=0.75、雨強60 mm/h且歷時超過集流時間。
optionsEn: A running pump necessarily delivers its rated drainage flow.
Absence of obvious noise proves sufficient suction-head margin.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume area 2 km², C=0.75 and intensity 60 mm/h lasting beyond concentration time.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設集水區2 km²、C=0.75、雨強60 mm/h且歷時超過集流時間；Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s，未含渠道滯蓄。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume area 2 km², C=0.75 and intensity 60 mm/h lasting beyond concentration time. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 集水區逕流峰值：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Catchment runoff peak: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「集水區逕流峰值」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Catchment runoff peak” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用雨量站與雷達核對雨強是否覆蓋集水區，再比較出口流量和延遲；將土地利用變更、排水分區和所選集流時間附在計算表。對雨量歷時與集流時間的比值作檢查，確認峰值公式沒有用在尚未全區貢獻的短雨。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check rain-gauge and radar coverage, then compare outlet flow and lag. Attach land-use changes, drainage boundaries and chosen concentration time to the calculation record. Compare storm duration with concentration time to ensure the peak formula is not applied before the full catchment contributes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以集水區逕流峰值編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用雨量站與雷達核對雨強是否覆蓋集水區，再比較出口流量和延遲；將土地利用變更、排水分區和所選集流時間附在計算表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for catchment runoff peak, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check rain-gauge and radar coverage, then compare outlet flow and lag. Attach land-use changes, drainage boundaries and chosen concentration time to the calculation record.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：短時局部暴雨可能不符合均勻降雨假設，排水瓶頸也會改變峰值時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Brief localized storms violate uniform rainfall assumptions, and drainage bottlenecks alter peak timing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用雨量站與雷達核對雨強是否覆蓋集水區，再比較出口流量和延遲；將土地利用變更、排水分區和所選集流時間附在計算表。對雨量歷時與集流時間的比值作檢查，確認峰值公式沒有用在尚未全區貢獻的短雨。
knowledge.textEn: Check rain-gauge and radar coverage, then compare outlet flow and lag. Attach land-use changes, drainage boundaries and chosen concentration time to the calculation record. Compare storm duration with concentration time to ensure the peak formula is not applied before the full catchment contributes.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以集水區逕流峰值編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用雨量站與雷達核對雨強是否覆蓋集水區，再比較出口流量和延遲；將土地利用變更、排水分區和所選集流時間附在計算表。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for catchment runoff peak, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check rain-gauge and radar coverage, then compare outlet flow and lag. Attach land-use changes, drainage boundaries and chosen concentration time to the calculation record.

quiz.question: 要驗證「集水區逕流峰值」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Catchment runoff peak"?
options: 用雨量站與雷達核對雨強是否覆蓋集水區，再比較出口流量和延遲；將土地利用變更、排水分區和所選集流時間附在計算表。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
縮短平均停留時間就能保證每個灣區都有效換水。
optionsEn: Check rain-gauge and radar coverage, then compare outlet flow and lag.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Shorter mean residence guarantees effective renewal in every reservoir arm.
quiz.explanation: 用雨量站與雷達核對雨強是否覆蓋集水區，再比較出口流量和延遲；將土地利用變更、排水分區和所選集流時間附在計算表。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check rain-gauge and radar coverage, then compare outlet flow and lag. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 集水區逕流峰值：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Catchment runoff peak: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「集水區逕流峰值」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Catchment runoff peak” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 短時局部暴雨可能不符合均勻降雨假設，排水瓶頸也會改變峰值時間。把每個分區峰值直接相加，可能錯估各峰不同時到達的真實入流。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Brief localized storms violate uniform rainfall assumptions, and drainage bottlenecks alter peak timing. Adding every subcatchment peak directly can misrepresent the actual combined inflow when peaks arrive at different times. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把每個分區峰值直接相加，可能錯估各峰不同時到達的真實入流。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Adding every subcatchment peak directly can misrepresent the actual combined inflow when peaks arrive at different times.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「各分區最大流量無須考慮時序就能直接相加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Subcatchment peak discharges can be added directly without considering their timing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 短時局部暴雨可能不符合均勻降雨假設，排水瓶頸也會改變峰值時間。把每個分區峰值直接相加，可能錯估各峰不同時到達的真實入流。
knowledge.textEn: Brief localized storms violate uniform rainfall assumptions, and drainage bottlenecks alter peak timing. Adding every subcatchment peak directly can misrepresent the actual combined inflow when peaks arrive at different times.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「集水區逕流峰值」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Catchment runoff peak" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
短時局部暴雨可能不符合均勻降雨假設，排水瓶頸也會改變峰值時間。
水庫水位不變就表示沒有大量水量流入與流出。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Brief localized storms violate uniform rainfall assumptions, and drainage bottlenecks alter peak timing.
An unchanged reservoir level means there is no substantial inflow or outflow.
quiz.explanation: 短時局部暴雨可能不符合均勻降雨假設，排水瓶頸也會改變峰值時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Brief localized storms violate uniform rainfall assumptions, and drainage bottlenecks alter peak timing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 庫容與淨入流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Storage and net inflow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「庫容與淨入流」如何影響新加坡濱海堤壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Storage and net inflow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Marina Barrage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水庫水位變化由入流減去閘排、抽水及其他出流決定。庫面不是永遠固定，低窪岸帶開始淹沒時，水位與庫容的關係會改變。 假設淨入流80 m³/s持續30 min、有效水面3 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m；只作固定面積短時估算。 抽水流量若採額定值而非當時揚程下的實際值，會產生虛假的未量測入流。時間步太長又可能把短時高峰平滑掉，低估岸邊淹水機會。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「庫容與淨入流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reservoir level changes with inflow minus gravity discharge, pumping and other losses. Surface area is not always constant; inundating low banks changes the stage-storage relation. Assume net inflow 80 m³/s over thirty minutes and effective area 3 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m, a short-duration constant-area estimate. Using rated pump discharge instead of flow at actual head creates false unexplained inflow. Long time steps smooth brief peaks and can underestimate opportunities for flooding along the reservoir edge. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Storage and net inflow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設淨入流80 m³/s持續30 min、有效水面3 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m；只作固定面積短時估算。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume net inflow 80 m³/s over thirty minutes and effective area 3 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m, a short-duration constant-area estimate.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水庫水位不變就表示沒有大量水量流入與流出。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An unchanged reservoir level means there is no substantial inflow or outflow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「庫容與淨入流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Storage and net inflow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 庫容與淨入流
knowledge.text: 水庫水位變化由入流減去閘排、抽水及其他出流決定。庫面不是永遠固定，低窪岸帶開始淹沒時，水位與庫容的關係會改變。
knowledge.textEn: Reservoir level changes with inflow minus gravity discharge, pumping and other losses. Surface area is not always constant; inundating low banks changes the stage-storage relation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水庫水位不變就表示沒有大量水量流入與流出。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An unchanged reservoir level means there is no substantial inflow or outflow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「庫容與淨入流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Storage and net inflow" is correct?
options: 水庫水位不變就表示沒有大量水量流入與流出。
平均庫位高於海面就保證所有瞬間都向海排水。
水庫水位變化由入流減去閘排、抽水及其他出流決定。
optionsEn: An unchanged reservoir level means there is no substantial inflow or outflow.
A higher mean reservoir level guarantees outward flow at every instant.
Reservoir level changes with inflow minus gravity discharge, pumping and other losses.
quiz.explanation: 水庫水位變化由入流減去閘排、抽水及其他出流決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Reservoir level changes with inflow minus gravity discharge, pumping and other losses. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 庫容與淨入流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Storage and net inflow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「庫容與淨入流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Storage and net inflow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設淨入流80 m³/s持續30 min、有效水面3 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m；只作固定面積短時估算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume net inflow 80 m³/s over thirty minutes and effective area 3 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m, a short-duration constant-area estimate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將每個流量來源按相同時間步積分，對照實測庫容變化；檢查水位站是否受局部風浪或排水噴流影響，再辨認水量平衡殘差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate each flow source on identical time steps and compare measured storage change.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設淨入流80 m³/s持續30 min、有效水面3 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m；只作固定面積短時估算。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume net inflow 80 m³/s over thirty minutes and effective area 3 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m, a short-duration constant-area estimate.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「庫容與淨入流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Storage and net inflow", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設淨入流80 m³/s持續30 min、有效水面3 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m；只作固定面積短時估算。
並聯兩台相同泵的總流量必定是單台的兩倍。
平均鹽度很低就表示所有深度的水質完全相同。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume net inflow 80 m³/s over thirty minutes and effective area 3 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m, a short-duration constant-area estimate.
Two identical parallel pumps always deliver twice the single-pump flow.
Low mean salinity means water quality is identical at every depth.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設淨入流80 m³/s持續30 min、有效水面3 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m；只作固定面積短時估算。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume net inflow 80 m³/s over thirty minutes and effective area 3 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m, a short-duration constant-area estimate. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 庫容與淨入流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Storage and net inflow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「庫容與淨入流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Storage and net inflow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將每個流量來源按相同時間步積分，對照實測庫容變化；檢查水位站是否受局部風浪或排水噴流影響，再辨認水量平衡殘差。縮短積分時間步再做水量閉合，檢查估算最大水位是否隨解析度提高而穩定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate each flow source on identical time steps and compare measured storage change. Check gauges for local waves or discharge jets before interpreting the water-balance residual. Repeat storage closure with shorter integration steps and check whether maximum estimated level converges as resolution improves. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以庫容與淨入流編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將每個流量來源按相同時間步積分，對照實測庫容變化；檢查水位站是否受局部風浪或排水噴流影響，再辨認水量平衡殘差。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for storage and net inflow, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Integrate each flow source on identical time steps and compare measured storage change. Check gauges for local waves or discharge jets before interpreting the water-balance residual.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：抽水流量若採額定值而非當時揚程下的實際值，會產生虛假的未量測入流。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using rated pump discharge instead of flow at actual head creates false unexplained inflow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將每個流量來源按相同時間步積分，對照實測庫容變化；檢查水位站是否受局部風浪或排水噴流影響，再辨認水量平衡殘差。縮短積分時間步再做水量閉合，檢查估算最大水位是否隨解析度提高而穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Integrate each flow source on identical time steps and compare measured storage change. Check gauges for local waves or discharge jets before interpreting the water-balance residual. Repeat storage closure with shorter integration steps and check whether maximum estimated level converges as resolution improves.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以庫容與淨入流編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將每個流量來源按相同時間步積分，對照實測庫容變化；檢查水位站是否受局部風浪或排水噴流影響，再辨認水量平衡殘差。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for storage and net inflow, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Integrate each flow source on identical time steps and compare measured storage change. Check gauges for local waves or discharge jets before interpreting the water-balance residual.

quiz.question: 要驗證「庫容與淨入流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Storage and net inflow"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將每個流量來源按相同時間步積分，對照實測庫容變化；檢查水位站是否受局部風浪或排水噴流影響，再辨認水量平衡殘差。
差壓增加只可能來自攔污柵堵塞，與流量無關。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Integrate each flow source on identical time steps and compare measured storage change.
Higher screen differential head only indicates blockage and is unrelated to flow.
quiz.explanation: 將每個流量來源按相同時間步積分，對照實測庫容變化；檢查水位站是否受局部風浪或排水噴流影響，再辨認水量平衡殘差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Integrate each flow source on identical time steps and compare measured storage change. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 庫容與淨入流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Storage and net inflow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「庫容與淨入流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Storage and net inflow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 抽水流量若採額定值而非當時揚程下的實際值，會產生虛假的未量測入流。時間步太長又可能把短時高峰平滑掉，低估岸邊淹水機會。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using rated pump discharge instead of flow at actual head creates false unexplained inflow. Long time steps smooth brief peaks and can underestimate opportunities for flooding along the reservoir edge. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：時間步太長又可能把短時高峰平滑掉，低估岸邊淹水機會。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Long time steps smooth brief peaks and can underestimate opportunities for flooding along the reservoir edge.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水庫水位不變就表示沒有大量水量流入與流出。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An unchanged reservoir level means there is no substantial inflow or outflow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 抽水流量若採額定值而非當時揚程下的實際值，會產生虛假的未量測入流。時間步太長又可能把短時高峰平滑掉，低估岸邊淹水機會。
knowledge.textEn: Using rated pump discharge instead of flow at actual head creates false unexplained inflow. Long time steps smooth brief peaks and can underestimate opportunities for flooding along the reservoir edge.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「庫容與淨入流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Storage and net inflow" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
平均庫位高於海面就保證所有瞬間都向海排水。
抽水流量若採額定值而非當時揚程下的實際值，會產生虛假的未量測入流。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A higher mean reservoir level guarantees outward flow at every instant.
Using rated pump discharge instead of flow at actual head creates false unexplained inflow.
quiz.explanation: 抽水流量若採額定值而非當時揚程下的實際值，會產生虛假的未量測入流。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using rated pump discharge instead of flow at actual head creates false unexplained inflow. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
